notes.title: PATCH 1.1.1
notes.notes: Fixed bug: Alien Codex not loading

notes.title: Minor Update 1.1.0 Teletubes
notes.notes:
Added: New Teletubes L-Shape-small, J-Shape-small and S-Shape
 Balance: Increased base value of C-Shape (0 → 2), L-Shape (0 → 1) and Straight-3 (0 → 1)
 Balance: Updated rarity of Straight-1 and L-Shape-mini from Common to Uncommon
 Fix: Resolved an issue where the boss effect tag could appear above tooltips

notes.title: PATCH 1.0.11
notes.notes:
Renamed: Meteorite → Meteookie (they do look like chocolate-chip cookies 🍪)
 Balance: Productier alien is now Rare
 Synergies: Explorer and Rollionaire now synergize with Miley and Incubator
 Stability: Hardened save/load to gracefully handle corrupted save files so the game stays playable
 SpaceBalls (clarity/UX): Primary colors (RedBall, GreenBall, BlueBall) now also list the secondary balls they merge with (CyBall, MagBall, YeBall). Hovering a primary SpaceBall also highlights those secondaries

notes.title: PATCH 1.0.10
notes.notes:
Made it clearer that savings are frozen during boss encounters. The total money counter is dimmed/masked and an alert clarifies that only fresh earnings pay the boss.
 Hovering NeMon, Nixie, or T1Rex now highlights the units/items they affect, so you can see at a glance what’s at risk. 
 Items and aliens affected by a boss now show that boss’s stamp overlay.
 Boss ship now starts closer during boss levels, making it much easier to hover over Bosses and read their effects at the beginning of a run.

notes.title: PATCH 1.0.9
notes.notes:
UI: Payment due now shows two decimals at high values (reveals the 5% step from Level 7).
 Bugfix: Planetoken was not working at 0 rerolls
 Bugfix: Sometimes a run started incorrectly with Puny Aliens
 Bugfix: Painter recoloring a SpaceBall no longer wipes its existing permanent bonuses.

notes.title: PATCH 1.0.8
notes.notes:
Buffed puny starter aliens
 Requirement to unlock better starter aliens is now Payment 1 (was Payment 2)
 Allow skipping starter aliens to open +1 extra cell
 Added Infinity hint to Dr. Doomix description: “Infinity lies beyond 1.8E308"
 Removed Boss tag from Dr. Doomix
 Bugfix: Technician alien in some cases interfered with Battery payout
 Bugfix: in some rare cases some cells would not be selectable during expansion phase
 Bugfix: If an upstream Multiplier targets two Mimicrons that both target a different (downstream) Multiplier, the second Mimicron no longer incorrectly gives $0

notes.title: PATCH 1.0.7
notes.notes:
Fixed: Extraction sometimes got stuck when the highest-value gnome departed (e.g. Cashperturnix)
 Fixed: Replacealienix sometimes spawned duplicate Unique alien
 Fixed: Exact boss payments sometimes failed on the final turn

notes.title: PATCH 1.0.6
notes.notes:
Improved settings reliability: Resolution, language, audio, and speed options now stay functional even if the save file is corrupted 

Fix UI: Tooltip no longer lingers when extracting with E hotkey while hovering an item

notes.title: PATCH 1.0.5
notes.notes:
Bugfix: Fixed a rare issue that could allow items to overlap/stack.
 Input: Ignore device-selection hotkeys (A/D/←/→/0–9) in the main menu while the Feedback form is open.
 Tooltip: Discharger description now explicitly says it discharges ALL full batteries.

notes.title: PATCH 1.0.4
notes.notes:
Fixed: alien Rollionaire exploit that gave money without rerolls
Fixed: Cell opened on Skip would sometimes close on Extract

notes.title: PATCH 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Play-scene feedback button is smaller and semi-transparent (more discreet)
Fixed: Exponaut alien now affects Spaceball OuLaLa correctly
Removed item tooltip hover SFX
Fixed: rare freeze after level completion

notes.title: Hotfix: Alien Tooltip
notes.notes: Fixed a rare bug causing missing alien tooltips and blocked selling.

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.notes: Fixed an (apparently rare) issue with the green alien effect text and alien snapping. Thanks to the players who reported this!

notes.title: 🚀📟 INVENTORIX Update: Smoother, Sharper, and Stronger! 🌟
notes.notes:
We've been hard at work refining and enhancing INVENTORIX based on your amazing feedback! Here's what’s new in the latest update:

🛠 What’s New:

 
 Save & Continue Feature Added 💾🔄
You can now pick up right where you left off!

 Difficulty Progression Revamped 🎯
Smoothed the difficulty curve to create a more balanced and enjoyable experience.

 Item Stats Adjusted ⚖️
Rebalanced item stats to keep gameplay fair and engaging.

 New Item: Mineral Xtal 💎
The Mineral Xtal joins the roster, replacing the machine X-Link!

 Clarity Improvements 📖
Updated item and alien descriptions for better in-game understanding.

 Tutorial Hints Flow Enhanced 🧭
Hints now seamlessly blend into gameplay for an intuitive, non-intrusive experience.

 Quality of Life (QoL) Upgrades ✨
Various tweaks to performance and user experience.

 Bug Fixes 🐛✅
Squashed several bugs to ensure smoother gameplay!



If you haven’t checked out INVENTORIX lately, now’s the perfect time!
Download the demo for free from our Steam page.

Your feedback is invaluable and helps shape the game! Let us know what you think. 🎮💬

Thank you for your continued support!
- Team Arcaludi
